output.reply: If your top-up was cancelled, the funds are usually returned to the original payment method. Please check your account activity; if the refund doesn’t appear within the expected processing time, contact us with the top-up details.

Sorry—the app seems to have undone your action during the top-up. Please check your balance and transaction history to confirm whether the top-up went through, and contact us with the details if it’s still unclear.
I’m sorry the app reversed your top-up. Please check your transaction history for the reversal details and contact us through the app with the transaction date and amount so we can look into it.
The exchange rate depends on the transaction and when it’s processed. Please check the rate shown before confirming; your statement may also include any applicable foreign transaction fees.

Cash deposits may take some time to appear. Check your receipt for the deposit details and allow time for processing. If it still hasn’t shown up after the expected processing time, contact us with the receipt so we can look into it.

I’m sorry the cash deposit from this morning hasn’t appeared yet. Please keep your receipt and check again later today, as processing can take some time. If it still hasn’t posted, contact us with the deposit details so we can look into it.

I’m sorry your cash deposit hasn’t appeared. Please contact us as soon as possible with the deposit date, amount, and receipt details so we can investigate. We can’t confirm a resolution time until we review it.

I’m sorry you’re dealing with this. Please lock your card in the banking app if available, and contact us through the number on the back of your card or in the app to report the unfamiliar charge and secure your account. Don’t share your PIN or one-time passcodes.
You can update your personal details in your account settings. If you can’t edit a particular detail, please contact us for help.
You can update your personal details through your online banking profile or by contacting us. For security, we may need to verify your identity.
You don’t need to wait for a post office form. Please update your address with us directly through your online banking or by contacting customer service.
We ask for identity details to protect your accounts, verify it’s really you, and help prevent fraud. We only request information needed for the service or security check.
We ask for information to confirm it’s really you and help protect your account from fraud. We only request details needed for verification; please don’t share passwords or one-time codes.

I’m sorry you’re having trouble logging in. Please check that you’re using your own username and the latest version of the app. If you still can’t sign in, contact us through the bank’s official website or phone number so we can help securely.

For security, your PIN can’t be viewed on the card. Please check your banking app or online banking for a PIN-related option, or contact us through an official channel to learn how to retrieve or change it.
You can usually set up your PIN in your bank’s mobile app or online banking under card settings, or by calling the number on the back of your card. The exact steps depend on your card and account.
For security, your PIN isn’t displayed in the app or online. Check your card’s PIN mailer, or use your bank’s app or website to request a PIN reminder or reset.
I understand you’d prefer a Mastercard. Please contact us or visit a branch to ask whether your account or card can be switched to one.

I’m sorry the exchange rate on your card payment seems incorrect. Please share the transaction date, amount, and currency so we can review how the rate was applied. Your card statement may also show the rate and any fees used.
You can usually top up your account by debit card in your bank’s app: open the account, choose “Add money” or “Top up,” and follow the prompts. Available options may vary by bank.
Yes, friends may be able to add money to your account, depending on your bank’s supported deposit methods. Please check your app or contact us for the available options and any requirements.
Could you clarify what you mean by “disposable cards”—virtual cards for one-time purchases, or something else? Limits can vary by card type.
You can freeze your card now in the bank’s mobile app or online banking under Card settings. If you can’t access those, contact us using the number on our website.
I’m sorry the exchange rate on your card payment looks incorrect. Please contact us with the transaction details so we can review the rate and any applicable fees.

I’m sorry this happened. Please review your recent transactions and contact us using the number on the back of your card to report any unauthorized charges and discuss securing or replacing the card. If you believe the card is still being used, freeze it in your banking app if that option is available.
Could you share what placard you mean, or upload a photo? Then I can help identify which ATMs accept it.
Please share your location or the ATM’s address, and I can help you determine the distance.

Please check your account activity for the deposit details, including the sender and date. If you don’t recognize the deposit, contact us using the number on your card or a secure channel in your banking app so we can review it. Please don’t spend or return the funds until we’ve confirmed what they are.

If you don’t recognize this payment, lock your card in the banking app if available and contact us immediately using the number on the back of your card or in the app. We can review the transaction and explain the steps to dispute it; whether it can be cancelled depends on its status.

I’m sorry this has happened. Please contact us immediately using the number on the back of your card or in our official app so we can help secure your account and investigate the transaction. Don’t share your PIN or one-time codes with anyone.

I’m sorry to hear about this unapproved deduction. Please review the transaction details in your account and contact us through the secure app or the number on your card so we can help investigate and explain how to dispute it.
You can reset your password using the “Forgot password” option on the sign-in page. Follow the prompts to verify your identity and create a new password.

There are several possible reasons, such as insufficient available funds, a card or ATM limit, or a temporary ATM issue. Please check your balance and card settings, or contact us with the transaction details so we can look into it.

An ATM transaction can be declined for several reasons, such as insufficient available funds, withdrawal limits, or a card or ATM issue. Please check your available balance and transaction limits, then try again or contact us with the time and location of the ATM so we can look into the specific decline.
To finalize a card payment, follow the confirmation steps shown by the merchant or payment terminal. If it remains pending, contact the merchant or check your banking app for its status.
I can help you check the payment’s status and expected processing time. Please check its details in your account or contact us with the payment date and type so we can look into it.

I’m sorry your phone is missing. If you use mobile banking, contact us through the number on the back of your card or visit a branch so we can help secure your account. You may also want to contact your mobile carrier to suspend the phone.

I’m sorry your phone is lost. Please contact us immediately using the phone number on the back of your card or visit a branch so we can help secure your accounts. If you use mobile banking, change your password from a trusted device and contact your mobile carrier to suspend your service.

You may still be able to access your account through online banking on another trusted device. Contact your bank promptly to block access from the lost phone and secure your account, especially if it had your banking app or saved passwords.

I’m sorry to hear that. Please contact the hotel’s front desk or lost-and-found as soon as possible. If your banking app or cards may be accessible on the phone, lock the device remotely and contact us to secure your accounts.

If you mean returning a purchase made with your bank card, please contact the retailer to ask about its return process. Any refund will be handled according to the retailer’s policy and may take time to appear in your account.

Even when the details are correct, a transfer may be declined because of insufficient funds, a transfer limit, a security check, or an issue with the recipient’s bank. Please check your transfer status and any message in your banking app, or contact us so we can look into the specific reason.
Could you clarify what you mean by “double check your funds may be declined”? Please share what transaction or service you’re asking about, without including your PIN or full account details.

I’m sorry the refund hasn’t appeared yet. Refund timing can vary by merchant and payment method. Please check the transaction details for an estimated posting date; if it’s past that date, contact us with the purchase details so we can look into it.

I’m sorry the refund isn’t showing on your statement. Refunds can take several business days to appear, depending on the merchant and your account. Please check again soon, and contact us with the transaction details if it still hasn’t appeared.

I’m sorry you haven’t seen the refund in your statement. Refunds can take several business days to appear. Please check with the merchant for the refund date and reference, then contact us if it still doesn’t show after the merchant’s stated timeframe.

Please check the transaction details in your statement to see what the €1 fee relates to. If it’s unclear or you don’t recognize it, contact us with the transaction date and details so we can look into it.

I’m sorry your card payment didn’t go through. Please check that your card is active, your available balance is sufficient, and the payment details are correct. If it still fails, contact us so we can look into it.

I’m sorry your new card payments are being declined. Please check that the card is activated and that the transaction details and available balance are correct. For help identifying the decline reason, contact us through the secure banking app or call the number on the back of your card.

I can help you understand how to close your account. For your security, please contact us through the app or call the number on the back of your card so we can verify your identity and review any steps needed before closure.

If an ATM kept your card, contact your bank as soon as possible to report it and ask to block the card and arrange a replacement. If the ATM is at a branch, notify staff; otherwise, note the ATM’s location and contact the operator too. Check your account for any unfamiliar transactions.

I’m sorry the ATM kept your card. Please contact your bank using the number on its official website or mobile app to report it and arrange a replacement. If the ATM is at a branch, you can also ask branch staff for help.

If an ATM has retained your card, please contact the bank that operates the ATM using the number displayed on it. If it’s your bank’s ATM, contact us so we can help secure your card and explain the next steps.

I’m sorry this happened. Please lock your card in the banking app or call the number on our official website right away, and contact the ATM operator to ask about retrieving it. Don’t share your PIN or card details here.

I’m sorry this happened. Contact your bank using the number on its official website or mobile app to report the card retained by the ATM and ask about blocking or replacing it. If the ATM is at a branch, alert staff; don’t accept help from strangers.

I’m sorry your card was retained. Please contact your bank using the number on its official website or app as soon as possible to block the card and arrange a replacement. If you’re at an ATM, note its location and contact the ATM operator; don’t accept help from strangers.
You can usually see where money came from in the transaction details or statement for your account. Select the credit or deposit in your banking app to view any available source information.
You can review your account statements and transaction history to see where deposits came from. If a transaction is unclear, contact us with its date and amount so we can help identify it.
Could you clarify which money you mean—such as a deposit, transfer, or cash withdrawal? I can then help explain where it came from.
You can request a new card PIN through your bank’s app, online banking, or customer service. Please use the option available for your account.
You can usually change your card PIN at an ATM or through your bank’s mobile app or online banking. Check your card settings or contact us if you need help finding the option.
Yes, you can usually transfer money to a beneficiary through online or mobile banking. Select the transfer option and add the beneficiary if needed; the exact steps depend on your bank’s service.

Sorry you're having trouble. Our bank does not support cryptocurrency exchanges, so we can’t troubleshoot the exchange itself. Please contact the crypto platform’s support team, and never share your banking password or verification codes.

I’m sorry you were charged unexpectedly. Transfer fees can depend on the transfer type and account. Please check the transaction details and your account’s fee schedule, or contact us with the transfer date and type so we can help identify the charge.

If your GBP salary has arrived in your account, you generally don’t need to configure it elsewhere. Check your account’s currency settings or contact us if you expected it to be converted or deposited into a different account.

Others can usually send you money by bank transfer using your account details, or through a supported payment service. The available options depend on your bank and country; please check your bank’s app or website for the details to share.
I’m sorry your transfer didn’t go through. Please check your balance and transfer details, then try again. If it still fails, contact us with the error message so we can help investigate.

A cash withdrawal may remain pending while the ATM or card network completes processing. Please check your account again later; if it remains pending or the amount is deducted without cash being dispensed, contact us with the transaction details so we can investigate.

You can add funds by transferring money from another bank account using your bank’s app or online banking. Select the option to transfer or add money, then follow the instructions. Available methods may vary by account.

You can transfer money through your bank’s app or online banking by choosing “Transfer” or “Payments,” selecting the source and destination accounts, entering the amount, and confirming the details. Menu options may vary; contact your bank if you need help finding them.

To transfer money into your account, use your bank’s app or online banking and select the transfer or deposit option. The available methods and steps depend on the type of transfer—what kind are you planning to make?
Your top-up verification code is usually sent by SMS or email to the contact details registered with your account. Check your messages, including spam or junk folders.

A pending transaction is a payment or withdrawal that has been authorized but hasn’t fully processed yet. If the ATM declined your withdrawal, the pending entry may be a temporary authorization and may clear automatically. You usually can’t cancel a pending card transaction yourself; contact your bank to check its status and ask what options are available.

You can pay by check by making it payable to the recipient and including their account or reference number, if required. Follow the payment instructions provided by the recipient or contact them to confirm where to send it.
Could you clarify which physical card you mean? Card prices and fees depend on the card type and your account. You can check the fee schedule in your banking app or contact us for details.
You can check your card’s delivery status and tracking number in your online banking account or mobile app. If it isn’t listed, please contact the bank for help.

Sorry you're having trouble using your disposable virtual card. Please check that it hasn’t expired and that the merchant accepts virtual cards. If it still doesn’t work, contact us through the app with the transaction details so we can help investigate.

There may be fees for withdrawing British pounds from a local ATM, depending on your account and the ATM operator. Please check your account’s fee schedule or contact us for details before withdrawing.

The number of transactions allowed with a disposable card can depend on your card provider’s rules. Check your card details in the app or contact your bank for the exact limit.

A top-up can fail for several reasons, such as insufficient funds, incorrect payment details, or a temporary issue. Please check the transaction details and any error message in the app; if you share the exact message, I can help explain it.

A top-up can be declined for several reasons, such as insufficient funds, a card limit, or a security check. Please check your available balance and any notifications in your banking app. For the specific reason, contact us through the app or call the number on your card.

Fees for topping up depend on the top-up method. Please check the fee information in the app before completing a top-up.
Fees may apply when adding money with an international card, depending on your card provider and the service you’re using. Please check the fee details shown before confirming the transaction.

You can usually activate your new card through your bank’s mobile app, online banking, or by calling the number on the card’s sticker. If you’re unsure which option applies, contact your bank using the number on its official website.
You can activate your new card using the bank’s app, online banking, or the phone number provided with the card. If you’re unsure which method applies, please contact us through an official channel.

To activate your new card, follow the instructions provided with it—typically by using it at an ATM with your PIN or making a purchase with your PIN. You can also check your bank’s app or contact customer service for the steps specific to your card.

To activate your card, follow the instructions included with it or use your bank’s mobile app, online banking, or the phone number on the card. If you can’t find the instructions, contact your bank using the number on its official website.
I understand you need your card quickly. Is this a replacement card, or are you asking about getting a new card? Please let me know so I can point you to the right options.

Your bank will typically send a replacement card before the current one expires. Check that your mailing address is up to date, and contact the bank if you haven’t received the replacement.

You can usually request a replacement card through your bank’s mobile app, online banking, or by calling the number on the back of your current card. Check your card settings for the replacement option, or contact your bank if you can’t find it.

Sorry your contactless card isn’t working. Check that contactless payments are enabled and that the card is held close to the reader. You may need to insert the card and enter your PIN to reactivate contactless. If it still doesn’t work, contact your bank to check the card.
Yes, you can usually add your card in the app under Cards or Manage cards. Follow the prompts to verify it; if you don’t see the option, contact us through the app for help.
Sorry you’re having trouble with contactless payments. Please check that contactless is enabled in your card settings and try again. If it still doesn’t work, contact us so we can check your card.

No. You generally don’t need to make a regular payment before using contactless, though your card must be active and have sufficient available funds. Check your card terms for any account-specific restrictions.

Transfer times vary depending on the payment method and the recipient’s bank. Some transfers arrive quickly, while others can take several business days. Accepted currencies vary by service and location. Please tell us which service or branch you’re asking about so we can provide the right information.
